description: This Java source file defines the 'UnknownPathException' class, a custom exception used in the Eclipse Ditto project to indicate that a given path does not match any known command, response, or event. It includes methods for creating instances from messages or JSON objects, and a builder class for constructing exceptions with detailed context.
